title: ZakatPlus — A More Personal & Trustworthy Digital Zakat Experience

content.text: ZakatPlus is a digital platform designed to make zakat distribution more transparent, personal, and impactful. The goal was to transform zakat from a purely administrative process into a meaningful and trusted user journey.

ZakatPlus — UX Case Highlight

While reviewing existing digital zakat experiences, I noticed a recurring pattern: users came with good intentions, but the experience felt overly administrative for something deeply personal.

They were often faced with too many program options, long form-like flows, and uncertainty about what happens after payment. As a result, zakat was treated as a task to complete rather than a meaningful act of worship.

This led to the core question: how might we design a zakat experience that is fast, personal, and trustworthy — without losing its spiritual meaning?

UX approach & key decisions:

  • - Introduced location-based recommendations to reduce decision fatigue and make the experience feel more personal and contextual
  • - Designed a conversational flow to replace long forms, lowering cognitive load and creating a familiar interaction model
  • - Highlighted a 100% cash distribution concept to simplify the value proposition and increase perceived trust and impact
  • - Built a Zakat Tracker to provide post-payment transparency and turn a one-time transaction into a continuous meaningful journey
  • - Reframed programs into human-centered impact categories (Jaga Sejahtera & Jaga Harapan) to help users choose based on meaning, not technical terms

Outcome:

A faster and more intuitive zakat experience with reduced friction, stronger user trust, and a more emotionally engaging journey — where users feel confident that their intention reaches the right people.
